description: ENTERPRISE-GRADE GENOMICS ANALYSIS: Comprehensive multi-omics analysis of TCGA Breast Cancer (BRCA) dataset covering 1,098 patients with clinical outcomes, gene expression (RNA-Seq + Microarray), somatic mutations, copy number alterations, DNA methylation, and protein quantification (RPPA). Generate publication-ready interactive dashboards, statistical models, and pathway enrichment analyses with strict bioinformatics best practices.

execution_preferences.task_organization: SEQUENTIAL PIPELINE: Execute 7 phases in strict order due to data dependencies. Each phase builds on previous outputs.
execution_preferences.detail_level: MAXIMUM - Enterprise genomics analysis requires complete statistical rigor

requirements: Extract and catalog all 59 files from tar.gz archive
Profile clinical data: 1,098 patients × 111 variables
Profile mutations: ~30K somatic variants across samples
Profile expression: RNA-Seq + microarray (20K genes)
Profile CNA: Segment-level and gene-level alterations
Profile methylation: HM450 platform (~450K probes)
Profile RPPA: ~200 proteins with phosphorylation status
Generate sample overlap Venn diagrams across data types
Create data completeness matrix
Clinical: MICE imputation, molecular subtype classification (Luminal A/B, HER2+, Triple-negative)
Expression: Log2 transform RSEM, quantile normalization, batch effect detection
Mutations: Filter non-synonymous, annotate drivers (OncoKB, COSMIC), calculate TMB
CNA: Segment by chromosome arm, GISTIC analysis, genome instability scores
Integration: Unified sample manifest, multi-omics data matrix
Survival analysis: Cox regression (univariate + multivariate), Kaplan-Meier curves
Differential expression: Volcano plots by molecular subtype
Pathway enrichment: GSEA (MSigDB Hallmark), KEGG cancer pathways, GO enrichment
Risk stratification: Clinical + molecular risk scores, ROC curves for survival prediction
Drug target identification: Map mutations to druggable genome
Interactive HTML dashboard with Plotly.js and DataTables
50+ publication-quality visualizations (SVG/PNG, 300 DPI)
OncoPrint, volcano plots, Circos plots, t-SNE/UMAP, forest plots, heatmaps
Kaplan-Meier survival curves with log-rank tests
PPI networks, pathway diagrams, mutation lollipop plots

data_extraction_schema_guidance.note: TCGA data follows standardized format. Preserve exact patient/sample IDs (TCGA-XX-XXXX format) for traceability.

mutation_data.processing: Filter Silent mutations, annotate cancer genes, calculate TMB

expression_data.normalization: Log2 transform, quantile normalization, batch effect correction if needed

quality_standards.data_integrity: Zero data loss during transformations, 100% sample ID traceability
quality_standards.statistical_rigor: FDR correction for multiple testing (Benjamini-Hochberg), proportional hazards validation for Cox models
quality_standards.visualization_quality: 300 DPI minimum, vector formats (SVG/PDF), interactive Plotly charts with zoom/pan
quality_standards.documentation: Comprehensive logging, QC checkpoints at every step, reproducible analysis code

tasks.task_name: Deep Structural Analysis and Data Profiling
tasks.description: Extract and comprehensively profile all 59 files from the TCGA BRCA archive, analyzing each data type for structure, quality, and relationships.

objectives: Extract all files from tar.gz archive and create complete file inventory
Profile clinical data: 1,098 patients × 111 variables (missingness patterns, distributions)
Profile mutations: Identify ~30K+ somatic variants (mutation burden per sample, gene frequency)
Profile expression: RNA-Seq (~20K genes) + Microarray (coverage, normalization status, batch effects)
Profile CNA: Segment-level and gene-level (CNV landscape, recurrent alterations)
Profile methylation: HM450 platform (~450K probes, beta value distributions)
Profile RPPA: ~200 proteins (abundance patterns, phosphorylation status)
Generate sample overlap analysis across all data types (Venn diagrams)
Create data completeness matrix showing which samples have which data types
Calculate file statistics and record counts for all files

detailed_requirements.file_extraction: Extract tar.gz to workspace, create CSV inventory with: filename, path, size, type, record_count
detailed_requirements.clinical_profiling: For data_clinical_patient.txt and data_clinical_sample.txt: Count patients/samples, identify categorical vs continuous variables, calculate % missing per variable, profile survival outcomes (OS_STATUS, DFS_STATUS), summarize biomarkers (ER/PR/HER2 prevalence)
detailed_requirements.mutation_profiling: For data_mutations.txt: Count total variants, variants per sample (TMB distribution), top mutated genes (TP53, PIK3CA, etc.), variant type breakdown (SNP/DEL/INS), functional impact (missense/nonsense/silent)
detailed_requirements.expression_profiling: For RNA-Seq and microarray files: Count genes, samples with expression data, check if already log-transformed, identify batch variables (tissue source site), calculate % genes with zero expression
detailed_requirements.cna_profiling: For CNA files: Count segments, samples, genes with alterations, identify GISTIC peaks (amplifications/deletions)
detailed_requirements.methylation_profiling: For methylation files: Count probes, samples, calculate beta value statistics (mean, median, range)
detailed_requirements.rppa_profiling: For RPPA files: Count proteins, samples, check normalization (z-scores available?)
detailed_requirements.sample_overlap: Create Venn diagram data showing: Samples with clinical only, clinical+expression, clinical+expression+mutations, etc. Calculate intersection counts
detailed_requirements.quality_metrics: For each file: Check for malformed records, duplicate IDs, outlier values, encoding issues

work_scope.data_relationships: Map patient IDs across files (TCGA-XX-XXXX format), identify which case_lists define cohorts, understand meta files (study metadata, data type descriptions)

validation_criteria: structure_analysis.json contains profiles for ALL 7 data types (clinical, expression, mutations, CNA, methylation, RPPA)
file_inventory.csv lists exactly 59 files with complete metadata
sample_overlap_matrix.csv shows intersection counts across data types
data_profile_report.html renders with tables and charts for each data type
All patient/sample counts match expected values (~1,098 patients)

tasks.description: Enterprise-grade preprocessing of all data types with standardization, missing value handling, normalization, and multi-omics integration.

objectives: Clean and standardize clinical data with MICE imputation
Normalize gene expression data (log2 transform, quantile normalization)
Filter and annotate mutation data (non-synonymous only, driver genes)
Process CNA data (segment by chromosome arm, GISTIC analysis)
Create integrated multi-omics data matrix
Build unified sample manifest with complete metadata
Generate comprehensive QC report for all transformations

clinical_cleaning.standardization: Convert categorical variables to consistent format (e.g., 'Positive'/'Negative' for biomarkers, not 'POS'/'NEG'/'pos')
clinical_cleaning.missing_values: Use MICE (Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations) for continuous variables (age, survival months), use mode for categorical variables, document imputation flags
clinical_cleaning.derived_variables: Create OS_STATUS_BINARY (0=Living, 1=Deceased), DFS_STATUS_BINARY (0=DiseaseFree, 1=Recurred), MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE (Luminal A: ER+/HER2-, Luminal B: ER+/HER2+, HER2-enriched: ER-/HER2+, Triple-negative: ER-/PR-/HER2-), AGE_GROUP (<40, 40-60, >60), STAGE_SIMPLIFIED (Early: I-II, Advanced: III-IV)
clinical_cleaning.biomarker_validation: Check ER/PR/HER2 concordance, flag suspicious cases (e.g., ER- but PR+), validate against expected prevalence
clinical_cleaning.survival_processing: Calculate survival in months from days, censor at last follow-up, validate against median survival literature values

expression_normalization.rnaseq: Load data_mrna_seq_v2_rsem.txt, apply log2(RSEM+1) transformation if not already logged, remove genes with median TPM < 1 (low expression), check for batch effects via PCA colored by TISSUE_SOURCE_SITE, apply quantile normalization if batch effects detected, save normalized matrix as Parquet
expression_normalization.microarray: Load data_mrna_agilent_microarray.txt, verify already log2-transformed, perform quantile normalization, merge with RNA-Seq data using common gene symbols, prioritize RNA-Seq when overlap exists
expression_normalization.quality_control: Plot density curves before/after normalization, calculate CV (coefficient of variation) per gene, identify outlier samples via hierarchical clustering

mutation_processing.filtering: From data_mutations.txt, keep only Variant_Classification in [Missense_Mutation, Nonsense_Mutation, Frame_Shift_Del, Frame_Shift_Ins, In_Frame_Del, In_Frame_Ins, Splice_Site], exclude Silent mutations
mutation_processing.annotation: Add cancer gene flags from known databases: COSMIC Cancer Gene Census (tier 1), OncoKB (oncogenes, tumor suppressors), mark driver mutations vs passengers
mutation_processing.tmb_calculation: Count non-synonymous mutations per sample, divide by exome size (38 Mb), create TMB categorical: Low (<5 mut/Mb), Medium (5-10), High (>10)
mutation_processing.hotspot_identification: Identify recurrent mutations: TP53 R175, R248, R273; PIK3CA E542K, E545K, H1047R; flag hotspot mutations

cna_processing.segmentation: From data_linear_cna.txt, calculate chromosome arm-level CNA (average per arm: 1p, 1q, 2p, etc.)
cna_processing.gistic_integration: Load data_gistic_genes_amp.txt and data_gistic_genes_del.txt, identify recurrently altered genes (GISTIC q-value < 0.25)
cna_processing.instability_score: Calculate genome instability: fraction of genome with |CNA| > 0.2, count breakpoints from segmented data
cna_processing.focal_vs_broad: Classify alterations: Focal (<50% chromosome arm), Arm-level (>50% arm), Whole-chromosome

integration.sample_manifest: Create unified CSV with columns: PATIENT_ID, SAMPLE_ID, HAS_CLINICAL (boolean), HAS_EXPRESSION, HAS_MUTATIONS, HAS_CNA, HAS_METHYLATION, HAS_RPPA, MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE, STAGE, AGE, OS_STATUS, OS_MONTHS
integration.data_matrix: Build multi-omics matrix: rows=samples, columns=[clinical variables, top 1000 variable genes, top 100 mutated genes (binary), top 50 CNA genes, top 100 methylation probes, all RPPA proteins]
integration.id_normalization: Standardize all IDs to TCGA-XX-XXXX-XX format, map between patient-level and sample-level IDs, validate no orphan samples

input_files: Depends on phase1_structure_analysis outputs: file_inventory.csv to locate extracted data files
validation_criteria: clinical_cleaned.parquet has 0% missing in key variables (PATIENT_ID, OS_STATUS, MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE)
expression_normalized.parquet shows CV < 0.8 for housekeeping genes
mutations_annotated.parquet has driver gene flags for all known cancer genes
integrated_samples_manifest.csv has 100% of patients from clinical data
normalization_qc_report.html shows before/after comparison plots

tasks.description: Statistical profiling and pattern discovery across clinical and molecular data with comprehensive summary statistics.

objectives: Analyze clinical characteristics: demographics, treatment patterns, biomarker prevalence
Profile molecular landscape: mutation frequencies, CNV patterns, expression clusters
Perform multi-omics integration: correlation analyses, subtype profiling
Identify outliers and data quality issues
Generate comprehensive statistical summary

detailed_requirements.clinical_eda: Age distribution (histogram, median, IQR), treatment frequencies (surgery types, radiation yes/no, chemotherapy yes/no), biomarker prevalence (ER+ %, PR+ %, HER2+ %, calculate with 95% CI), stage distribution (bar chart: Stage I/II/III/IV percentages), subtype frequencies (pie chart: Luminal A/B, HER2+, Triple-negative), survival summary (median OS, median DFS by subtype)
detailed_requirements.molecular_eda: Top 20 mutated genes (bar chart with mutation frequency %), mutation signatures (SBS signatures if possible, or simple C>T, C>A transition/transversion ratios), CNV landscape (chromosome ideogram showing recurrent gains/losses), expression clustering (hierarchical clustering of top 500 variable genes, identify cluster count via gap statistic), methylation patterns (beta value distributions, hypermethylated vs hypomethylated CpG islands), protein pathway heatmap (RPPA data, hierarchical clustering of proteins by pathway)
detailed_requirements.multi_omics_integration: Expression-CNA correlation (Spearman correlation for genes with CNA, identify cis-acting effects), expression-methylation anti-correlation (promoter methylation vs gene expression), subtype-specific profiles (volcano plots showing DE genes per subtype), outlier detection (Mahalanobis distance in PCA space, flag top 5% outliers)
detailed_requirements.statistical_tests: Chi-square tests for categorical associations (subtype vs stage, biomarkers vs stage), t-tests for continuous comparisons (age by subtype, TMB by subtype), correlation matrices (Spearman for expression-clinical associations)
detailed_requirements.summary_statistics: Create JSON with: patient_count, median_age, biomarker_prevalence, subtype_distribution, mutation_landscape_top20, median_survival_by_subtype, data_completeness_by_type

input_files: Depends on phase2_cleaning_normalization outputs: all cleaned parquet files, integrated_samples_manifest.csv
validation_criteria: eda_statistics.json contains all required summary metrics
eda_comprehensive_report.html has visualizations for all data types
Biomarker prevalence matches literature (ER+ ~75%, HER2+ ~15%)
Top mutated genes include TP53, PIK3CA, GATA3, CDH1
correlation_matrices.parquet has significance p-values

tasks.description: Create enterprise-grade interactive dashboard with 50+ publication-quality visualizations using Plotly and DataTables.

objectives: Generate Kaplan-Meier survival curves (interactive Plotly)
Create OncoPrint for mutation and CNA co-occurrence
Build volcano plots for differential expression
Design Circos plots for chromosomal aberrations
Develop t-SNE/UMAP for multi-omics integration
Assemble master interactive dashboard with all visualizations

detailed_requirements.survival_plots: Kaplan-Meier curves using Plotly: OS by molecular subtype (4 curves, log-rank p-value, median survival labels), DFS by stage (4 curves), OS by biomarker status (ER+/-, PR+/-, HER2+/-), waterfall plot showing treatment timeline per patient (sorted by survival), Sankey diagram for treatment pathways (surgery → radiation → chemotherapy flow)
detailed_requirements.molecular_visualizations: OncoPrint: Top 25 mutated genes × all samples (mutations as colored bars, CNA as background shading), Volcano plots: DE analysis for each subtype vs others (log2FC on x-axis, -log10(p-value) on y-axis, label top 20 genes), Lollipop plots: Protein domain mutations for TP53, PIK3CA, GATA3 (show domains as boxes, mutations as lollipops), Circos plot: Chromosomal view with outer ring=chromosome, inner arcs=translocations/CNV, heatmap ring=expression, t-SNE plot: 2D embedding of multi-omics matrix (color by subtype, size by survival), UMAP plot: Alternative dimensionality reduction (color by stage)
detailed_requirements.statistical_plots: Forest plot: Cox regression hazard ratios for all variables (Age, Stage, Grade, ER, PR, HER2, TMB) with 95% CI, Violin plots: Gene expression distributions by subtype for top 20 genes, Heatmaps: Top 50 variable genes with hierarchical clustering (annotate with subtype, stage), RPPA heatmap: All proteins with phosphorylation status
detailed_requirements.dashboard_structure: Multi-tab HTML layout: Tab 1: Executive Summary (KPIs, key findings), Tab 2: Clinical Overview (demographics, survival KM), Tab 3: Mutation Landscape (OncoPrint, mutation frequency bars), Tab 4: Expression Analysis (volcano plots, heatmaps, PCA), Tab 5: CNA Landscape (Circos, chromosome ideograms), Tab 6: Multi-omics Integration (t-SNE, UMAP, correlation heatmaps), Tab 7: Statistical Models (forest plots, Cox results table)
detailed_requirements.interactivity: All Plotly charts: zoom, pan, hover tooltips with sample IDs, export as PNG/SVG, DataTables: sortable columns, search bar, export to CSV/Excel, pagination, Filters: dropdown to subset by subtype/stage/biomarker, dynamic chart updates

technical_requirements.libraries: Use Plotly.js 2.27.0 CDN for all interactive charts, jQuery 3.7.1 + DataTables 1.13.7 for tables, Bootstrap 5.3 for responsive layout, D3.js 7.8 for custom Circos plot
technical_requirements.figure_quality: All static exports: 300 DPI minimum, SVG format for vector graphics, PNG for raster with high resolution, consistent color scheme across all plots (use colorblind-safe palette)
technical_requirements.data_embedding: Embed small datasets (<1MB) directly in HTML as JavaScript variables, larger datasets: load from JSON files via fetch(), implement loading indicators for async data loads

input_files: Depends on phase2_cleaning_normalization and phase3_eda outputs: all cleaned data, statistics, correlation matrices
validation_criteria: dashboard_master.html loads without errors and displays all tabs
At least 50 visualizations generated (count all charts and plots)
All Plotly charts are interactive (zoom, pan, hover work)
DataTables have search, sort, and export functionality
All figures exported to both SVG and PNG formats

tasks.description: Comprehensive survival analysis using Cox proportional hazards regression and Kaplan-Meier methods with risk stratification.

objectives: Perform Cox regression for overall survival (OS) and disease-free survival (DFS)
Generate Kaplan-Meier curves with log-rank tests
Identify prognostic gene signatures
Build risk stratification models
Create survival prediction ROC curves

detailed_requirements.cox_regression: Univariate Cox models: Test each variable independently (Age, Stage, Grade, ER_STATUS, PR_STATUS, HER2_STATUS, MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE, TMB, top 100 genes), extract HR, 95% CI, p-value, Multivariate Cox model: Include significant univariate variables (p < 0.05), check proportional hazards assumption (Schoenfeld residuals), report final adjusted HRs with p-values, stratify by stage if proportional hazards violated
detailed_requirements.kaplan_meier: OS by molecular subtype: 4 curves (Luminal A, Luminal B, HER2+, Triple-negative), calculate median survival per group, log-rank test for significance, DFS by treatment: Compare surgery types, radiation yes/no, OS by stage: Stratify into Early (I-II) vs Advanced (III-IV), highlight 5-year survival rates, Gene-based KM: For top prognostic genes, split samples at median expression, plot high vs low expression survival
detailed_requirements.prognostic_signatures: Identify genes associated with survival: For each gene in expression_normalized.parquet, perform univariate Cox regression on OS, rank by -log10(p-value), extract top 50 genes, Validate against known signatures: Check overlap with PAM50 genes, OncotypeDX genes, MammaPrint genes, create signature score: weighted sum of prognostic gene expression, test signature in Cox model
detailed_requirements.risk_stratification: Build clinical risk score: Age (>60 = +1), Stage (III-IV = +2), Grade (3 = +1), HER2+ (=+1), range 0-5, Build molecular risk score: TMB High (+1), TP53 mutated (+1), PIK3CA mutated (-1, protective), prognostic signature score (tertiles: low=0, medium=+1, high=+2), Combined risk model: Clinical + Molecular score, stratify patients: Low risk (0-2), Medium (3-5), High (>5), ROC analysis: Predict 3-year and 5-year survival using risk scores, calculate AUC, sensitivity, specificity at optimal threshold

input_files: Depends on phase2_cleaning_normalization outputs: clinical_cleaned.parquet, expression_normalized.parquet, mutations_annotated.parquet
validation_criteria: cox_univariate_results.csv has results for all tested variables
Multivariate model includes age, stage, and molecular subtype at minimum
Prognostic signature has significant association with OS (p < 0.05)
Risk stratification shows significant separation in KM curves (log-rank p < 0.001)
ROC AUC > 0.65 for 5-year survival prediction

tasks.description: Functional genomics analysis including GSEA, pathway enrichment, protein-protein interaction networks, and drug target identification.

objectives: Perform gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) for hallmark pathways
Analyze subtype-specific pathway enrichment
Build protein-protein interaction networks
Identify druggable targets from mutation and expression data

detailed_requirements.gsea_analysis: Load MSigDB Hallmark gene sets (H.all.v2023.1), run GSEA for each molecular subtype vs others (Luminal A, Luminal B, HER2+, Triple-negative), use pre-ranked GSEA with log2FC as ranking metric, extract enriched pathways: FDR < 0.25, NES > 1.5 for upregulated, NES < -1.5 for downregulated, visualize top 10 pathways per subtype as bubble plot (x=NES, y=pathway, size=gene set size, color=FDR)
detailed_requirements.kegg_pathways: Test enrichment in KEGG cancer pathways: Breast cancer pathway (hsa05224), PI3K-Akt signaling (hsa04151), MAPK signaling (hsa04010), Cell cycle (hsa04110), p53 signaling (hsa04115), use hypergeometric test on differentially expressed genes per subtype, report pathways with FDR < 0.05
detailed_requirements.go_enrichment: Run GO enrichment for Biological Process: Test upregulated genes (FC > 2, FDR < 0.05) per subtype, extract top 20 GO terms per subtype, visualize as dot plot with gene ratio and significance
detailed_requirements.subtype_pathways: Luminal subtypes: Expected pathways (ER signaling, steroid hormone response, cell adhesion), HER2+ subtype: Expected pathways (ERBB signaling, cell proliferation, DNA repair), Triple-negative subtype: Expected pathways (immune response, EMT, stem cell signatures), compare pathway activity scores across subtypes using ssGSEA
detailed_requirements.ppi_networks: Use STRING database API to fetch protein-protein interactions for: Top 50 mutated genes, Top 100 DE genes per subtype, build network graph with nodes=genes/proteins, edges=interactions (confidence > 0.7), identify hub genes (degree > 10), run community detection (Louvain algorithm), visualize network with nodes colored by functional module
detailed_requirements.drug_targets: Map mutations to druggable genome: PIK3CA mutations → PI3K inhibitors (alpelisib), ERBB2 amplification → HER2 inhibitors (trastuzumab, pertuzumab), ESR1 mutations → selective ER degraders, check for actionable alterations in OncoKB database, prioritize targets: Tier 1 (FDA-approved drugs), Tier 2 (clinical trials), create drug-target-patient matrix showing which patients have druggable alterations

input_files: Depends on phase2_cleaning_normalization and phase3_eda outputs: expression_normalized.parquet, mutations_annotated.parquet, eda_statistics.json
validation_criteria: GSEA identifies ER signaling pathway enriched in Luminal subtypes
KEGG enrichment includes breast cancer and PI3K-Akt pathways
PPI network has >50 nodes and >100 edges
druggable_targets.json identifies PIK3CA and ERBB2 as top targets
At least 30% of patients have at least one druggable alteration

objectives: Assemble all analysis results into unified HTML report
Create executive summary with key findings
Organize all datasets into data package
Generate supplementary materials and documentation
Ensure reproducibility with analysis code

report_structure.section1_executive_summary: Key findings: Total patients analyzed, molecular subtype distribution, median survival by subtype, top 5 mutated genes with frequencies, most enriched pathways per subtype, druggable alterations prevalence, Sample statistics: Patients with complete multi-omics data, data completeness percentages, QC metrics: Samples excluded (if any), data quality flags, normalization methods applied
report_structure.section2_clinical_characteristics: Demographics table: Age distribution, race/ethnicity, menopause status, Treatment summary: Surgery types and frequencies, radiation therapy %, chemotherapy %, Biomarker prevalence: ER+ %, PR+ %, HER2+ % with 95% confidence intervals, Stage distribution: Pie chart and table, Survival outcomes: Median OS and DFS overall and by subtype, KM curves embedded
report_structure.section3_molecular_landscape: Mutation landscape: OncoPrint for top 25 genes, mutation frequency bar chart, TMB distribution, Copy number alterations: Circos plot, recurrent amplifications/deletions table, GISTIC peaks, Gene expression: PCA plot colored by subtype, heatmap of top 50 variable genes, volcano plots for each subtype, Methylation: Beta value distributions, differential methylation analysis, Protein expression: RPPA heatmap, pathway activity scores
report_structure.section4_survival_analysis: Cox regression results: Forest plot with HRs and 95% CI for all variables, table of univariate and multivariate results, Kaplan-Meier analysis: KM curves by subtype, stage, biomarkers with log-rank p-values, median survival tables, Prognostic signatures: List of genes associated with survival, signature performance metrics, Risk stratification: Risk score distribution, KM curves by risk group, ROC curves for survival prediction
report_structure.section5_multiomics_integration: Correlation heatmaps: Expression vs CNA, expression vs methylation, Subtype molecular profiles: Radar charts showing pathway activity per subtype, Dimensionality reduction: t-SNE and UMAP plots with subtype overlays, Outlier analysis: Samples flagged as outliers with reasons
report_structure.section6_pathway_analysis: GSEA results: Top enriched pathways per subtype with NES and FDR, enrichment plots for key pathways, KEGG pathways: Breast cancer pathway diagram with DE genes highlighted, GO enrichment: Dot plots for biological processes, PPI network: Network graph with hub genes labeled, Drug targets: Table of actionable alterations with drug recommendations
report_structure.section7_quality_control: Data completeness: Matrix showing % samples with each data type, Normalization QC: Before/after plots for expression, methylation, Batch effects: PCA plots colored by technical variables, Outlier detection: Methods and samples flagged
report_structure.section8_appendices: Methods: Detailed description of all analysis methods, statistical tests used, software versions, Data dictionary: Complete variable descriptions for all datasets, References: Citations for methods, databases, gene sets, Analysis code: Links to scripts used for each analysis step

detailed_requirements.interactive_features: Table of contents: Sticky sidebar with anchor links to all sections, collapsible on mobile, Expandable sections: Click to expand/collapse subsections for cleaner navigation, Searchable tables: All data tables with DataTables (search, sort, filter, export), Figure downloads: Buttons to download each figure as PNG or SVG, Data exports: Links to download underlying data for each analysis
detailed_requirements.data_package_organization: Create data_package/ directory with subdirectories: cleaned_data/ (all parquet files + CSV versions), figures/ (all high-res figures organized by analysis type), tables/ (supplementary tables as CSV), models/ (saved Cox models, risk scores), raw_results/ (GSEA results, enrichment results, network files), Create README.md with data dictionary and file descriptions
detailed_requirements.supplementary_materials: supplementary_tables.xlsx: Excel workbook with multiple sheets (Cox results, GSEA, druggable targets, etc.), analysis_code.zip: All Python scripts used with comments and usage instructions, data_provenance.json: Complete record of data sources, versions, download dates, processing log.txt: Timestamped log of all processing steps

Table of contents has links to all 8 main sections

additional_instructions: This is an enterprise-grade genomics analysis requiring strict adherence to bioinformatics best practices. All statistical tests must use appropriate multiple testing corrections (FDR/Bonferroni). Survival analyses must check proportional hazards assumptions. Gene set enrichments must use established databases (MSigDB, KEGG, GO). All patient identifiers must be preserved exactly as in source data for traceability. Create comprehensive logs documenting all data transformations. Generate QC plots at every major processing step. Ensure all outputs are publication-ready quality.
